cohort: 405 pregnant women, 211 not in labor and 194 in labor, were recruited from the Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology at Christian Medical College, Vellore, Tamil Nadu, India.
finding: Ultrasound estimation of bladder volume showed an excellent correlation (ICC 0.88, 95%CI 0.86-0.90) with catheter measurement for predicting significant bladder volume requiring catheterization in both laboring and non-laboring women.
